post.title: Overleaf wants $25 a month. Aldine doesn't.
post.caption: Two fresh grudges: a paywall on LaTeX collaboration and a subscription to sync your own notes, both replaced by people annoyed enough to build the free version.

segments.quote: Most need a paid subscription service to enable proper collaboration

cues.say: Overleaf wants twenty-five dollars a month

cues.cap: so your co-author can edit too.

cues.say: [sarcastic] Most need a paid subscription service

segments.quote: without paying for a subscription or handing my data over to big corporations like Google or Microsoft.

cues.say: Obsidian Sync wants five dollars a month

cues.cap: to put your notes on your phone.
or handing my data over to big corporations

cues.say: [quick] So: Git Writer. Your own repo.

cues.cap: All built out of pure spite.
